user.title: WattTime
user.description: WattTime has no sign-up web page; accounts are created through its API. Pick "Create an account" if you don't have one yet.

login.title: Sign in to WattTime
login.description: The location picks your grid region. Free accounts get the 0-100 index everywhere, and full data (live emissions, forecasts, health damage) for California ISO North. See [plans]({plans_url}).

register.title: Create a WattTime account
register.description: This sends your details to WattTime's /register endpoint ([API docs]({docs_url})), then signs in. The location picks your grid region.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: WattTime no longer accepts the password for {username}.

error.invalid_auth: WattTime rejected the username or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach WattTime. Try again in a minute.
error.no_region: WattTime has no grid region for this location.
error.register_failed: WattTime did not create the account. The username may be taken or the password too weak; check the log for WattTime's message.

abort.already_configured: This grid region is already set up.

init.title: What counts as clean
init.description: "Clean" means emissions are in the cleanest part of the look-ahead, and never above the maximum.

data_description.clean_percentile: 25% matches WattTime's own index (0-25 is its cleanest quarter).
data_description.clean_max: Gas plants run about 385-470 g/kWh, so 227 keeps an all-gas day from being called clean.
data_description.lookahead_hours: Up to 72 hours. WattTime's index always compares against the next 24 hours.

no_entry.message: No WattTime Status entry is loaded.

pick_entry.message: More than one WattTime Status entry is set up; choose one with config_entry_id.

no_forecast.message: This account has no forecast for this region yet.

get_forecast.name: Get forecast
get_forecast.description: Returns the CO2 forecast for the look-ahead, in 5-minute steps, in the unit you chose.

config_entry_id.name: Region
config_entry_id.description: Which WattTime entry to use. Only needed if you set up more than one.
